recipe.build:
rm src-tauri/gen/android/keystore.properties
RUSTUP="$(sed -rn 's/rustup\s+(.+)/\1/p' .build-tool-versions)"
RUST_TOOLCHAIN="$(sed -rn 's/rust\s+(.+)/\1/p' .build-tool-versions)"
NODE="$(sed -rn 's/node\s+(.+)/\1/p' .build-tool-versions)"
wget -q -O /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -- https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.14.1/node-v24.14.1-linux-x64.tar.xz
sha256sum -c <<< '84d38715d449447117d05c3e71acd78daa49d5b1bfa8aacf610303920c3322be  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v24.14.1-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b $RUSTUP
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
export NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_NDK
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUST_TOOLCHAIN --target aarch64-linux-android --target armv7-linux-androideabi --target i686-linux-android --target x86_64-linux-android
source $HOME/.cargo/env
cargo install tauri-cli@2.9.5
npm ci
cargo tauri android build --split-per-abi --target aarch64
find . -name '*.apk'
mv src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/arm64/release/app-arm64-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
